items.title: Pilbara traditional owners set to appeal Fortescue's $150m native title penalty
items.description: Yindjibarndi native title holders have voted to continue their decades-long legal battle with mining billionaire Andrew Forrest.

items.title: Neptune's moon system is bizarre. JWST data helps explain why
items.description: Neptune's strange moon and ring system has puzzled astronomers for decades, but data from the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) might help explain how it formed.

items.title: Why China's memory chips could help end 'RAMageddon'
items.description: China's leading memory chip maker CXMT is emerging as a potential alternative source of memory for a market under strain from the AI boom, observers say.

items.title: FIFA wants to sell the World Cup to a Trump associate. Here's what we know
items.description: Gianni Infantino's plan to sell stakes in FIFA's events and competitions arm to investors would grant them control over the World Cup and has drawn condemnation from the organising confederations.

items.title: A turbulent week in Victorian politics has Canberra on high alert
items.description: With a new premier installed in Victoria there are questions about what the state's electoral situation could mean federally, for all parties.

items.title: Kumanjayi Little Baby murder case adjourned due to extensive evidence
items.description: The evidence against Jeffferson Lewis for the alleged murder of five-year-old Kumanjayi Little Baby outside Alice Springs is so extensive the case has had to be adjourned until December, a court has heard.

items.title: US strikes 'dozens of targets' in Iran as war threatens to engulf Middle East
items.description: America's military strikes "dozens" of Revolutionary Guard targets across Iran, as the spread of hostilities to Egypt, Iraq and Saudi Arabia threatens to plunge the rest of the Middle East into all-out conflict.

items.title: Online watchdog takes Telegram to court over terrorism videos
items.description: The Office of the eSafety Commissioner will allege Telegram neglected its legal obligations when it allowed videos, including of the Christchurch mosque massacre, to remain on the platform.

items.title: Shadow minister calls for federal MP to step down over assault charges
items.description: Federal Labor MP Luke Gosling has been charged with assaulting NT Administrator David Connolly at a Thai festival earlier this month.

items.title: Tasmanian producer pulls products after Four Corners report
items.description: The labels on some of Tasmanian producer Stuart Young's handcrafted goods say some ingredients may come from "further afield". But that was a reference to the Australian mainland, not China.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
